name: Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi Temple
description: A major religious site associated with the birthplace of Lord Krishna.

name: Dwarkadhish Temple
description: A historic Krishna temple known for its religious and architectural importance.
cultural_significance: One of the important temples visited by pilgrims in Mathura.

name: Vishram Ghat
description: A prominent ghat on the Yamuna River and an important cultural site.
cultural_significance: Associated with traditional religious activities and evening rituals.

name: Banke Bihari Temple
description: A famous Krishna temple and major pilgrimage destination in Vrindavan.
cultural_significance: One of the most visited religious sites in Vrindavan.

name: ISKCON Vrindavan
description: A well-known Krishna temple complex with devotional activities and cultural programs.

name: Prem Mandir
description: A large temple complex known for its architecture, gardens and evening illumination.
cultural_significance: Popular destination for visitors interested in spirituality and architecture.

name: Govardhan Hill
description: A sacred hill associated with Krishna traditions and pilgrimage.
cultural_significance: Important pilgrimage location near Mathura and Vrindavan.

name: Mathura Local Food Market
description: A local area where visitors can experience traditional Mathura food and sweets.
cultural_significance: Provides an opportunity to experience local food culture.
